$comment: STUMPS v1.0 error code registry. Source: DATABASE_AND_REALTIME_ARCHITECTURE.md §8, GAME_RULES_AND_STATE_MACHINES.md §7/§12/§15, master §8. Codes are stable identifiers; messages are human copy and may change.

VALIDATION_FAILED.meaning: Malformed payload or unknown field (strict schema)

UNKNOWN_COMMAND.meaning: Command type not in the socket/HTTP allowlist (e.g. auction.sell, card.award)

PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.meaning: Payload exceeds 16 KiB (5 MiB admin import)

GATE_INVALID.meaning: Wrong access code or missing/expired/revoked gate grant

GATE_REQUIRED.meaning: Valid Auth but no bound gate grant (E03)

FORBIDDEN.meaning: Actor lacks the capability for this resource/action

STEP_UP_REQUIRED.meaning: Sensitive admin change needs MFA within 5 minutes

ORIGIN_FORBIDDEN.meaning: Origin header not in exact allowlist

CSRF_INVALID.meaning: Missing or invalid session-bound CSRF token

TICKET_INVALID.meaning: Socket ticket unknown, expired, consumed or wrong origin

SELECTOR_ONLY.meaning: Only the current card selector may choose a category

NOT_RECIPIENT.meaning: Only the friend-request recipient may accept

CHAT_FORBIDDEN.meaning: Actor is not in the channel audience

JOIN_FAILED.meaning: Generic room join failure (bad code or password); does not reveal which

STATE_CONFLICT.meaning: Illegal transition for current phase; reply includes fresh allowed actions

STALE_COMPARISON.meaning: Card command for an old comparison

STALE_BID.meaning: Bid for an old nomination version or wrong amount

ALREADY_LEADING.meaning: Franchise already holds the high bid (no self-raise)

CONTROL_EPOCH_STALE.meaning: Command fenced by a newer control epoch

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.meaning: Same command ID reused with a different body hash (E44)

FRANCHISE_TAKEN.meaning: Franchise already claimed in this room

VOTE_IN_PROGRESS.meaning: An end vote is already open

VOTE_ALREADY_CAST.meaning: Ballot is immutable; a changed choice is rejected

ALREADY_COMPLETED.meaning: Game naturally completed before the vote request (E54)

ROOM_GONE.meaning: Room deleted/expired; duplicate command cannot recreate it

VOTE_EXPIRED.meaning: Ballot processed at or after expiresAt (E52)

RULE_VIOLATION.meaning: Generic rule validation failure with details

GAME_MISMATCH.meaning: Valid invite belongs to the other game type (E37)

CONFIG_INVALID.meaning: Room settings outside documented bounds (e.g. uneven card total E40)

BUDGET_RESERVE.meaning: Bid exceeds purse minus minimum-roster reserve; details.allowedCeiling

XI_INFEASIBLE.meaning: Acquisition would make a legal XI impossible

GAME_PAUSED.meaning: Gameplay frozen by vote or recovery pause

PAUSE_NOT_ALLOWED.meaning: Host pause outside inter-player boundary or limits

VOTE_LIMIT.meaning: Three failed votes already used in this room

LAST_ADMIN.meaning: Operation would lock out the last super admin

INTERNAL.meaning: Unexpected failure; correlation ID only, no stack/SQL
